description: Answers of the public mainnet node (https://rpc.mainnet.midnight.network) to the IN-8 calls below, recorded over JSON-RPC on 2026-10-25 for the node client tests (task 10.1). The block is the finalized head at recording time, height 0x306fbc = 3174332; System.Number (twox128(System) ++ twox128(Number)) at that block reads 0xbc6f3000, the same height as a little-endian u32; chain_getBlockHash(0) is the genesis hash test/ledger/fixtures/genesis/node-roots.json records for mainnet; system_properties.genesis_state is the hex (no 0x) of test/ledger/fixtures/genesis/genesis_state_mainnet.mn.
